_comment: Two entries, so `a1.js`, `w1.js`, `a2.js` and `w2.js` are in one common chunk. `main.js` defers `a1.js` and `a2.js`, and `b.js` imports the four modules in that order. A new chunk with `w1.js` and `w2.js` would load at one place, so no init of `a2.js` could run between them. Thus the chunk keeps its modules, and runs `a1.js` and `a2.js` at load, at their places, as the build without `import defer` does.
